decisions.reason: As an incremental burner component with lower public visibility than a stand-alone system, it is the easiest to withdraw, but the firm is growing and it still fits the established radiant-heating business so management is likely to continue it.

The dedicated web page signals visible commitment, and an electric infrared panel heater supports the firm's move toward lower-carbon building-climate solutions, which makes management inclined to persist.

Although this electric halogen infrared heater may be somewhat more niche, it received a stand-alone presentation and sits close to the core offer, so escalation of commitment still favors keeping it on the market.
This industrial electric infrared hall heater matches the firm's customer base and strategic direction, and the dedicated product-page commitment makes a near-term withdrawal unlikely.

The hydrogen-capable dark infrared heater is highly aligned with the firm's announced hydrogen-ready, lower-carbon path and was publicly highlighted with a concrete reference installation, so management is very likely to stay committed despite any early uncertainty.
